items.text: THE REMAINING GUARDS DECIDE TO LEAVE YOU ALONE.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE GUARD CAPTAIN STEPS FORWARD. 'PLEASE LET US SHOW YOU THE WAY.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOU ARE ROUSTED BY THE CITY WATCH AND TOLD TO MOVE ALONG. WHAT DO YOU DO?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration, ending with a direct question

items.text: NOTICES FOR TEACHERS AND STUDENTS ARE POSTED ON THE WALLS. A NOTE DIRECTS MAGIC USERS AND CLERICS TO GO NORTH AND FIGHTERS AND 'ROGUES' TO GO EAST.
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A SIGN ON THE WALL DIRECTS MAGIC USERS TO GO THROUGH THE EAST DOOR AND CLERICS TO GO THROUGH THE WEST DOOR.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE ROOM IS FILLED WITH DUELING PAIRS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE ARENA MASTER ASKS IF YOU WISH TO DUEL. 'THE DUELS ARE EVENLY MATCHED AND NORMALLY NOT TO THE DEATH. DO YOU DUEL?'
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: I CANNOT ARRANGE SUCH A DUEL.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'DO YOU SEEK A PARTNER FOR YOUR ADVENTURING?'
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'THERE IS NO ONE WHO WILL GO WITH YOU.'
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO CONSIDER SOMEONE ELSE?'
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A SIGN ON THE NORTH DOOR READS 'FIGHTERS'.
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A SIGN ON THE NORTH DOOR READS 'ROGUES'.
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'YOUR PARTY IS TOO LARGE TO JOIN AT THIS TIME. RETURN WHEN IT IS SMALLER.'
items.direction: Measured fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A SCYTHING BLADE DROPS ACROSS THE DOORWAY, DAMAGING ONE OF THE CHARACTERS.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear action and danger

items.text: THE PARTY HEARS THE CRACKING OF GLASS. A POISONOUS GAS FILLS THE AIR!
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear action and danger

items.text: AFTER THE PARTY ENTERS THE ROOM A NET LACED WITH SHARP BLADES FALLS ON THE PARTY.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear action and danger

items.text: PILED HERE IS VARIOUS LOOT. THERE IS A WIDE VARIETY OF NICK NACKS FROM TARNISHED BRONZE CANDLESTICKS TO ONE OR TWO USEFUL ITEMS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: IN FRONT OF YOU ARE THREE CABINETS. WHICH ONE WILL YOU EXAMINE?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration, ending with a direct question

items.text: INSIDE THE CABINET YOU FIND SOME FILES. YOU STUFF THE PAPERS INTO YOUR JOURNAL UNDER ENTRIES 23 AND 14.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: IT IS LOCKED. HOW WILL YOU OPEN THE LOCK?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration, ending with a direct question

items.text: NO ONE IN THE PARTY HAS THE KNOCK SPELL! HOW WILL YOU OPEN THE LOCK?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration, ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU PICK THE LOCK!
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU HAVE ALREADY TRIED TO PICK THIS LOCK AND HAVE FOUND THAT IT IS TOO COMPLEX FOR YOU TO HANDLE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU TRY TO PICK THE LOCK BUT IT IS TOO COMPLEX FOR YOU TO PICK. YOU FAIL MISERABLY.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: WITH ONE MIGHTY SWING YOU SMASH OPEN THE LOCK MAKING ENOUGH NOISE TO WAKE THE DEAD.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THIS CABINET IS EMPTY.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: INSIDE THE CABINET YOU FIND FIFTEEN SACKS FILLED WITH SILVER PIECES.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: INSIDE THE CABINET YOU FIND EIGHTEEN SACKS FILLED WITH GOLD PIECES.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU TRY TO DEACTIVATE THE TRAP YOU MANAGE TO SET IT OFF. A LARGE NEEDLE SHOOTS OUT OF A HIDDEN COMPARTMENT HITTING A PARTY MEMBER.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear action and danger

items.text: YOU AVOID THE TRAP BY NOT OPENNING THE CABINET.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear action and danger

items.text: YOU SEE A WIDE COLLECTION OF RUGS AND TAPESTRIES. TWO OF THEM LOOK EXTRAORDINARY WHILE THE OTHERS LOOK AVERAGE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: IN FRONT OF YOU IS A WOODEN CABINET. WHAT WILL YOU DO?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration, ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU FIND A WIDE VARIETY OF SCROLLS IN SCROLL CASES.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THIS CABINET IS EMPTY.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU ATTEMPT TO DISARM THE TRAP, IT GOES OFF IN YOUR FACE! A CLOUD OF POISONOUS YELLOW GAS FILLS THE ROOM.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear action and danger

items.text: YOU AVOID THE TRAP BY NOT OPENING THE CABINET!
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear action and danger

items.text: BEFORE YOU IS A TABLE WITH FOUR SMALL CASKETS ON TOP OF IT. WHAT WILL YOU DO?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration, ending with a direct question

items.text: WHICH CASKET WILL YOU SEARCH?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration, ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU FIND A POUCH OF SMALL GEMS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene
